title: Report Suspected Fraud Calls and Messages — Sanchar Saathi (Chakshu)
publisher: Department of Telecommunications, Government of India
text: The Department of Telecommunications' Sanchar Saathi portal provides the Chakshu facility for citizens to report suspected fraud communication received by call, SMS or WhatsApp — for example messages about KYC updates, fake customer care, impersonation of government officials, sextortion, or offers of jobs, loans and lotteries. Reports help authorities take action against the numbers and connections used for fraud. Sanchar Saathi also lets users check which mobile connections are registered in their name and report lost or stolen phones. Chakshu is for reporting suspected fraud attempts; if money has already been lost, the victim should immediately call the cybercrime helpline 1930 or file a complaint at cybercrime.gov.in, and inform their bank.
